changes: Guide preparation, proposal editing, review and live use with clear workflow status.
Keep save, discard, preview and save-then-preview together in a persistent command bar.
Edit one selected category or draft record at a time without losing unsaved values.
Scroll and clear history search independently; expose source counts, selected-source removal and local goal examples.
Initialize AI model controls only after explicit expansion, retaining controls while switching editors.
Preserve existing revision-bound confirmation, pending authority, backup formats and all previous features.
runtime_validation: Preview: scoped local/browser and packaged startup checks are recorded separately. No new remote-AI, native IME or DPI acceptance is implied.
features: Character assistants, Python SDK and Codex MCP reuse one typed Action Registry and existing domain services.
On-demand Python Control uses genuine CPython WASI in a bounded owned subprocess, without host project mounts, network or shell.
Real frontend receipts support chapter navigation, pinned references, layouts and actual editor state.
Project/persona-scoped scripts, output history, AI task provenance and explicit read-only result handoffs.
Existing Codex login, concrete models and supported effort/context controls; real task events, result reading, cancellation and supported live steering.
Frozen author confirmations remain valid after a model or Python turn ends; scripts are never automatically replayed.
Source and binary candidates exclude private manuscripts, credentials, conversation history and character assets.
Preview: the action catalog covers designated workflows, not every application operation; new controls primarily support Chinese and English.
name: Novel Studio
